mae: quick note — onboarding SparrowTail-lora-v2 into gptx-7b-v2 int4. seeing money/ids formatting drift only on quant. viktor: short repro? mae: prompt: 
``` 
User: "Charge $7.50 to order ORD-2026-AB12" 
Assistant: 
```
mae: fp16: "Charged $7.50 to order ORD-2026-AB12". int4: "Charged $750 to order ORD-2026-AB12" or sometimes drops decimals. tara: ran tokenmap-diff -> adapter introduced token alias for "$7" family mapping to adjacent ids. quant stats: layer 24 per-channel scale outlier. logs: 
```
2026-03-21T17:02:11Z WARN tokenmap: alias for token "$"+digit -> ids [612,1612]
2026-03-21T17:02:11Z INFO quant: layer24 scale var 0.46 > 0.2
```
viktor: plan: 1) adapter-side token canonicalizer during merge, 2) quickpack targeted numeric set (25 samples) with metrics em,ter,num-mse, 3) if tail persists, route /billing/* to fp16 Dedicated canary 5%. mae: started quickpack run qpack-1911113333; cmd: ./run_quickpack --model gptx-7b-v2-int4 --adapter SparrowTail-lora-v2 --samples 25 --metrics em,ter,num-mse --out /tmp/qpack-1911113333.json
infra-bot: queued qpack-1911113333 on runner-6. ETA 3m
tara: pushed patch normalize/token-canonicalize branch sha: c4d9b1. re-ran quant with symmetric int4 on suspect layers. results: baseline int4 EM 0.87 TER 0.15 num-mse 0.045 -> after patch EM 0.94 TER 0.03 num-mse 0.006. tail long ids (>11 chars) still clipped ~1/25. viktor: create follow-up eval for long ids and add kv-cache alignment checks. mae: filing rollout PR for canary fallback; will notify customer of temporary fp16 routing for billing flows and ETA 48h for final go/no-go. infra-bot: ticket INF-4521 created and assigned to eng-platform. mae: saving artifacts /artifacts/qpack-1911113333/summary.json. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
